chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:

"When the sun passes its zenith, the gates of the heaven and the gates of the Gardens are opened, and supplication is answered. So glad tidings to the one for whom a righteous deed is raised at that time."

key_terms.أَبْوَابُ السَّمَاءِ: the gates of heaven, indicating divine openness and acceptance
key_terms.أَبْوَابُ الْجِنَانِ: the gates of Paradise, indicating mercy and reward
key_terms.زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ: the sun passed its zenith, meaning the onset of midday after noon
key_terms.عَمَلٌ صَالِحٌ: a righteous deed accepted and worthy of being raised

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of the time when the sun passes its zenith in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the time after the sun passes its zenith as a blessed moment in which the gates of heaven and Paradise are opened and du'a is answered. It highlights the virtue of performing righteous deeds and turning to Allah at that time, especially in connection with salat.
